coupling: The first edited commit raises the SIMD start-bits scan's accepted range limit from four to five while every temporary remains consistently sized by that same limit. The later interface commit introduces a separate four-entry storage constant for the x86 range array while the extraction call continues to use the five-range limit. Each change is invariant-preserving in its own context, but their composition passes max_ranges=5 to extract_start_bits_ranges() while its output array has only four entries. A public pattern such as [acegi] has five singleton ranges, so pcre2_jit_compile() writes ranges[4] beyond the stack array. A reviewer must compare the later storage declaration with the earlier raised limit and extraction call; changing only one side of that cross-commit invariant without understanding the other leaves the capacity/count relationship unresolved.
